name: Blitzcrank
title: the Great Steam Golem

Q.name: Rocket Grab
Q.description: Blitzcrank fires their right hand, Pulling the first enemy hit towards them and dealing 110/160/210/260/310 + 1.2×AP magic damage.
Q.summary: Blitzcrank fires their right hand to grab an opponent on its path, dealing damage and dragging it back to them.

W.name: Overdrive
W.description: Blitzcrank supercharges themself, gaining 60/65/70/75/80% decaying Move Speed and 30/40/50/60/70% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. Afterwards, Blitzcrank is Slowed by 30% for 1.5 seconds.
W.summary: Blitzcrank super charges themself to get dramatically increased Move and Attack Speed. They are temporarily slowed after the effect ends.

E.name: Power Fist
E.description: Blitzcrank charges up their fist, causing their next Attack to Knock Up for 1 second(s) and deal 2×AD + 0.25×AP physical damage.
E.summary: Blitzcrank charges up their fist to make the next attack deal double damage and pop their target up in the air.

R.name: Static Field
R.description: Passive: While this ability is available, lightning charges Blitzcrank's fists, marking those Attacked. After 1 second, they are shocked for 50/100/150 + 0.3/0.4/0.5×AP + ? magic damage. Active: Blitzcrank overcharges, dealing 275/400/525 + 1×AP magic damage and Silencing nearby enemies for 0.5 seconds. Their shields are also destroyed.
R.summary: Enemies attacked by Blitzcrank are marked and take lightning damage after 1 second. Additionally, Blitzcrank can activate this ability to remove nearby enemies' shields, damage them, and silence them briefly.

Passive.name: Mana Barrier
Passive.description: Blitzcrank gains a shield based on their mana when dropping to low health.
Passive.summary: Blitzcrank gains a shield based on their mana when dropping to low health.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Hook support who pulls enemies with Q and knocks them up with E. Wins lane with pulls that set up kills and peels with R silence.
strengths: Q pulls the first enemy hit toward him
E empowered attack knocks up for 1 s
R active silences nearby enemies for 0.5 s and destroys shields
W gives big move and attack speed for engages
Passive gives a shield based on his mana at low health
weaknesses: Missed Q leaves him with long cooldown (20–16 s)
profile.curveNote: Q+E is his kill combo at 2; level 1 Q is a threat too.

Q.notes: Pull; blockable by projectile blocks and minions.

W.notes: Speed and attack speed, then self-slow.

E.notes: Empowered attack knock-up 1 s; dodged by Jax E.

R.notes: Passive: marks attacked targets. Active: silence 0.5 s; removes shields.

profile.windowAgainst: Q on cooldown (missed): he has no threat.
